title: Minimum Operations to Make the Array Alternating
goal: Change the fewest values so every even index shares one value and every odd index another.
strategy: Keep the most frequent value in each parity group unless those values conflict. Comparing the top two candidates from each side is sufficient to find the best distinct pair.
